recording.description: Animated sequences assembled from 18 real browser screenshots, captured while scrolling down and up. GIF timing is illustrative; it is not a continuous video or an FPS measurement.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Actual script tested in isolated harness, including toggling; CSS override reviewed. Browser used its normal device preference.
accessibility.noJavascript: Public HTML has no presence classes or opacity defaults; CSS fallback is 1; unsupported-observer and failure paths tested.
